**Creme Puff** (August 3, 1967 – August 6, 2005) was a mixed tabby domestic cat, owned by Jake Perry of Austin, Texas. She was the oldest cat ever recorded, according to the 2010 edition of _Guinness World Records_,[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-1) when she died at the age of 38 years and 3 days.
Perry had another cat, Grandpa Rexs Allen, who is the fourth-oldest cat ever recorded. Perry said Grandpa was born in Paris, France, on February 1, 1964, and died aged 34 years and 59 days on April 1, 1998. Grandpa was posthumously awarded 1999 Cat of the Year by _Cats & Kittens_ magazine.
Jake Perry has owned many cats and almost all have lived past their 30's.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-2)
Creme Puff's owner, Jake Perry, said her diet consisted of dry cat food and claimed he supplemented it with broccoli, eggs, turkey bacon, coffee with cream, and every two days "an eyedropper full of red wine." Perry claimed that this diet was key to her longevity, and that the wine "circulated the arteries."[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-3) Coffee and alcohol are generally understood to be toxic to cats, however.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-pph1-4)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-VM1-5)

Perry turned his garage into a movie theater that played nature documentaries. He installed steps onto his walls for the cats to climb and built a screened enclosure in his backyard to allow the pets to enjoy the outdoors.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-6)

This is a dynamic list and may never be able to satisfy particular standards for completeness. You can help by editing the page to add missing items, with references to reliable sources.
This is a list of the oldest cats in the world, verified or not, listed by reported age, all of whom have attained the minimum age of 30 years.
Some of the ages reported here are approximate. Others are based on either estimates or hearsay. Few of them have been confirmed by any authoritative agency. **Creme Puff** (August 3, 1967 – August 6, 2005) was a mixed tabby domestic cat, owned by Jake Perry of Austin, Texas. She was the oldest cat ever recorded, according to the 2010 edition of _Guinness World Records_,[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-1) when she died at the age of 38 years and 3 days.
Perry had another cat, Grandpa Rexs Allen, who is the fourth-oldest cat ever recorded. Perry said Grandpa was born in Paris, France, on February 1, 1964, and died aged 34 years and 59 days on April 1, 1998. Grandpa was posthumously awarded 1999 Cat of the Year by _Cats & Kittens_ magazine.
Jake Perry has owned many cats and almost all have lived past their 30's.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-2)
Creme Puff's owner, Jake Perry, said her diet consisted of dry cat food and claimed he supplemented it with broccoli, eggs, turkey bacon, coffee with cream, and every two days "an eyedropper full of red wine." Perry claimed that this diet was key to her longevity, and that the wine "circulated the arteries."[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-3) Coffee and alcohol are generally understood to be toxic to cats, however.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-pph1-4)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-VM1-5)

**Creme Puff** (August 3, 1967 – August 6, 2005) was a mixed tabby domestic cat, owned by Jake Perry of Austin, Texas. She was the oldest cat ever recorded, according to the 2010 edition of _Guinness World Records_,[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-1) when she died at the age of 38 years and 3 days.
Perry had another cat, Grandpa Rexs Allen, who is the fourth-oldest cat ever recorded. Perry said Grandpa was born in Paris, France, on February 1, 1964, and died aged 34 years and 59 days on April 1, 1998. Grandpa was posthumously awarded 1999 Cat of the Year by _Cats & Kittens_ magazine.
Jake Perry has owned many cats and almost all have lived past their 30's.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-2)
Creme Puff's owner, Jake Perry, said her diet consisted of dry cat food and claimed he supplemented it with broccoli, eggs, turkey bacon, coffee with cream, and every two days "an eyedropper full of red wine." Perry claimed that this diet was key to her longevity, and that the wine "circulated the arteries."[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-3) Coffee and alcohol are generally understood to be toxic to cats, however.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-pph1-4)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-VM1-5)

Perry turned his garage into a movie theater that played nature documentaries. He installed steps onto his walls for the cats to climb and built a screened enclosure in his backyard to allow the pets to enjoy the outdoors.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creme_Puff_(cat)#cite_note-6)
